result.title: ECMR: Evidence-Aware Deliberation Control for Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning
result.comment: 32 pages, including references and technical appendices
result.summary: Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems typically commit to a deliberation protocol before inference. A fixed protocol cannot allocate computation differently to resolved and unresolved instances, and it may mistake repeated support for independent confirmation. We study this failure as semantic false consensus: a confident group answer supported by narrow, duplicated, or correlated rationales. We introduce ECMR, an evidence-aware controller over frozen role-conditioned LLMs. At each step, ECMR summarizes answer concentration, support diversity and independence, contradictions, role behavior, verification history, and remaining budget, then selects whether to propose, challenge, verify, arbitrate, diversify, correct a role, or stop. We formulate this decision as finite-horizon budgeted control and derive sufficient conditions under which state conditioning, risk-triggered verification, and role correction improve cost-adjusted utility. Across a declared held-out evaluation of 9,000 records from MedQA, CaseHOLD, and FinQA, ECMR-Full increases pooled accuracy from 62.1% to 84.9%, reduces false-consensus rate from 40.7% to 17.0%, and raises evidence-support rate from 58.0% to 88.7%. State shuffling loses 11.7 accuracy points with only 0.7 fewer rounds, while harder traces shift from early stopping toward arbitration. ECMR-Full uses the largest token budget, yielding the strongest absolute reliability rather than uniformly superior token efficiency.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把多智能体 LLM 的固定审议流程诊断为「语义虚假共识」，提出证据感知控制器 ECMR：在冻结的角色化 LLM 上逐步汇总答案集中度、支持多样性与独立性、矛盾、角色行为、验证历史与剩余预算，据此选择提议、质疑、验证、仲裁、多样化、纠错或停止，并形式化为有限时域预算控制。
AI.relevance_reason: 其状态条件化控制、风险触发验证与停止/仲裁决策，可能为 LVR 的 THINK/LOOK/STOP 成本权衡、证据筛选与贡献分配提供可核查的控制器设计线索，但论文限于纯文本多智能体，迁移到视觉侧需自行验证。
